brief: Prioritise the Penrose Ferry transformer for pre-event attention ahead of a younger unit in otherwise similar condition because its advanced age and history of high loading leave it with a reduced margin against mechanical failure. As stated in MG-023, where an ageing unit cannot be attended before an event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure. Refer to MG-023 and MG-021 for the specific requirements.
